name: Cap
description: Cap is a lightweight, privacy-friendly CAPTCHA alternative to reCAPTCHA and hCaptcha that uses proof-of-work instead of puzzles or tracking. This is its self-hosted server (capd): a dashboard to manage site keys, the challenge endpoints the widget talks to, and a siteverify API your backend uses to check tokens.

notes.text: Sign in to the dashboard with the admin key (ADMIN_KEY in /opt/cap-captcha_data/.env).
Stored site key secrets are encrypted with the admin key. After changing ADMIN_KEY, reset each site key's secret.

app_vars.name: var_admin_key
app_vars.label: Admin Key
app_vars.help: Dashboard password, at least 12 characters; generated when left empty
